directAnswer: To troubleshoot a CAPTCHA, ensure your browser is up to date and check for any browser extensions that may interfere with CAPTCHA functionality.
summary: This guide provides steps to troubleshoot common CAPTCHA issues across various platforms.

sections.heading: Check Browser Settings
sections.body: Ensure your browser settings allow cookies and JavaScript, as these are often required for CAPTCHA to function properly.

sections.heading: Disable Browser Extensions
sections.body: Some browser extensions, particularly ad blockers or privacy tools, can block CAPTCHA. Temporarily disable these extensions to see if it resolves the issue.

sections.heading: Check Network Connection
sections.body: A poor or unstable internet connection can lead to CAPTCHA errors. Try switching to a different network or restarting your router.

steps.title: Update Your Browser
steps.detail: Ensure you are using the latest version of your browser. Check the browser's settings or help menu for update options.

steps.title: Clear Browser Cache
steps.detail: Clear your browser's cache and cookies. This can often resolve issues related to stored data interfering with CAPTCHA.

steps.title: Test in Incognito Mode
steps.detail: Open a new incognito or private browsing window. This disables extensions and can help identify if they are causing the issue.

faqs.question: What should I do if I keep getting the same CAPTCHA?
faqs.answer: If you repeatedly encounter the same CAPTCHA, try refreshing the page or clearing your browser's cache.

faqs.question: Can using a VPN affect CAPTCHA?
faqs.answer: Yes, using a VPN can sometimes trigger CAPTCHAs more frequently due to perceived unusual activity.

faqs.question: Why do I see CAPTCHAs on certain websites only?
faqs.answer: Some websites implement CAPTCHA based on user behavior or traffic patterns, which may vary from site to site.

caveats: CAPTCHA implementations may vary by website, so steps may differ slightly.
Some issues may be related to the specific CAPTCHA provider (e.g., Google reCAPTCHA) rather than your settings.
